blocks.text: HOT TUB REMOVAL FAQ
Hot Tub Removal in Markham — What to Know Before You Book

items.q: How much does hot tub removal cost in Markham?
a: Pricing is confirmed on site once the crew sees the tub’s size, condition and how hard it is to get to — a portable spa costs less than a full six-seater with tight gate access. The number covers draining, cutting, hauling, certified electronics recycling and disposal together, with nothing added afterward.

items.q: What happens to the hot tub's control panel and electronics?
a: They’re recycled properly as standard, not an add-on. The control panel, heater element and pump motor route to certified electronics recyclers, with documentation available if your household needs the record — the same standard we’d want in a city built on technology.

items.q: Do I need to drain the hot tub myself before you arrive?
a: No — draining is part of the service. The Live Junk Free crew handles it safely on arrival, and you don’t need a hose, a pump, or any prep beyond making sure the area around the tub is reasonably accessible.

items.q: Is it safe to remove a hot tub that's still wired to electrical?
a: Only once the power is confirmed off. If your tub has a hardwired 240V connection, we ask that a licensed electrician disconnect it before the crew arrives — we don’t disconnect live electrical ourselves, for your safety and ours.

items.q: Can you remove a hot tub from a condo rooftop or terrace near Commerce Valley?
a: Yes, and it’s handled by the building’s book. Certificates of insurance go to management at booking, freight elevators reserve ahead, and the tub is cut down and carried through common areas without a mark left behind.
